Stoneridge Investment Partners Boosted Tiffany & Co (TIF) Stake by $5.39 Million; Gateway Advisory Lowered Philip Morris Intl (PM) Holding as Share Price Declined
May 19, 2018 - By Marguerite Chambers
Gateway Advisory Llc decreased its stake in Philip Morris Intl Inc (PM) by 81.61% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Gateway Advisory Llc sold 14,887 shares as the company’s stock declined 7.57% with the market. The institutional investor held 3,355 shares of the farming and seeds and milling company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $354,000, down from 18,242 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Gateway Advisory Llc who had been investing in Philip Morris Intl Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $125.52 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.36% or $0.29 during the last trading session, reaching $80.75. About 5.98 million shares traded. Philip Morris International Inc. (NYSE:PM) has declined 13.93% since May 19, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 25.48% the S&P500.
Stoneridge Investment Partners Llc increased its stake in Tiffany & Co (TIF) by 183.74% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Stoneridge Investment Partners Llc bought 52,310 shares as the company’s stock declined 6.13% with the market. The institutional investor held 80,780 shares of the consumer specialties company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $8.40M, up from 28,470 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Stoneridge Investment Partners Llc who had been investing in Tiffany & Co for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $12.87B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.80% or $0.83 during the last trading session, reaching $103.35. About 1.02 million shares traded. Tiffany & Co. (NYSE:TIF) has risen 1.55% since May 19, 2017 and is uptrending.
